name: BrightGene Bio-Medical Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: BrightGene Bio-Medical Technology Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, development, production, and sale of pharmaceutical products in China and internationally. The company develops BGM0504 injection, which is in Phase III clinical trial for treatment of type 2 diabetes and weight loss; and BGM1812, a long-acting amylin analog in preclinical development.
